difficulty_reason: The lemma records formal smoothness in the adic topology for three power series rings: over a field of characteristic zero over the rationals, over a field of positive characteristic over the prime field, and over a Cohen ring over the integers. The proof reduces all three to the corresponding statements about the coefficient rings by the universal property of power series rings, then quotes the separability criterion for the two field cases and, for the Cohen ring, the standard formal smoothness statement, checking the topological hypothesis by observing that a power of the prime vanishes in the test algebra because the kernel of the test diagram is nilpotent.
